full_form_context.text:
ATTACHMENT -10

                                   (To be submitted by Tenderer)


                      MINIMUM PLANTS & EQUIPMENTS FOR THE WORK

                           (TO BE DEPLOYED AS AND WHEN REQUIRED)


       Tenderers should have the following plant and machinery either owned or leased or hired by him.

        Sl.
              Type of equipment required for the work         Proposed to be deployed


       1    Diamond  disc  Cutter/floor saw  machine  with               3 Nos
               suitable capacity

       2    Wall Sawing Machine with suitable capacity                    3 Nos

       3     Electric Drill Motors/ Hammer drilling machine                  4 Nos


       4     Floor Saw Machine with suitable capacity                      4 Nos

       5    Chipping Machine                                        12 Nos

       6    Crusher/Combi Crusher                                    2 Nos

       7     Hydraulic Mobile crane                                     2 Nos

       8    High/Long Reach Demolition equipment as per               1 Nos
              the requirement

       9     Hydraulic rock breaker with loader                            2 Nos

      10  DG set 100kV or higher capacity                             2 Nos


  NOTE:
        1.  Plant and Equipment indicated above is minimum to be deployed at appropriate stage of the work.
          However, depending on the requirement to complete the work in the stipulated completion period,
           the tenderer should deploy additional machinery as circumstances warrant at no extra cost.
        2.  Plant and equipment to be mobilized for the work shall be in good serviceable condition.
